name: relay-inbox
description: Agent Relay inbox: polls the relay for this role's unread messages, shows them in a band above the prompt with Read and Reply, hands them to the model on the next turn, and wakes an idle session when new ones arrive.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Base URL of the Agent Relay Worker, for example https://agent-relay.<account>.workers.dev (https; plain http only for localhost or 127.0.0.1)

role_token.title: Role token
role_token.description: Bearer token of the role this session plays: its inbox is read and its replies are sent as that role.

poll_seconds.title: Inbox poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check the relay for unread messages. At least 15.

auto_wake.title: Wake an idle session
auto_wake.description: When new messages arrive and no turn is running, start a turn that tells the role to check its relay inbox.
